name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt a single 4px #005fcc focus ring with a 2px white box-shadow blur on every interactive element. This keeps the ring visible against any background while avoiding the complexity of stacking two rings. The trade-off is slightly softer edges on high-contrast backgrounds, but the blur ensures clarity without visual noise.

name: Reader
text: The single 4px ring with white blur may not be enough, as it fails on high-contrast mode and the white shadow can get lost. A better alternative would be to use a high-contrast outline that adapts to the background, ensuring the focus ring remains visible in all modes. To settle the argument, we need to test the proposed solution with users who rely on high-contrast mode and verify that our chosen approach meets the accessibility standards.
